definitions.explanation: A country that extracts crude oil and exports it as a significant part of its economy. Often used in discussions of international economics, energy policy, and geopolitics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中東|ちゅうとう}→中東：17924_chuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}。
examples.english: Oil-producing countries in the Middle East.

examples.japanese: {産油国|さんゆこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を{巡|めぐ}って→を巡って：27595_womegutte⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}している→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Oil-producing countries are at odds over petroleum prices.

examples.japanese: サウジアラビア⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{有数|ゆうすう}→有数：13006_yuusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Saudi Arabia is one of the world's leading oil-producing countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減産|げんさん}→減産：20416_gensan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦{原油|げんゆ}→原油：21637_genyu⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}した→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: After major oil-producing countries agreed to cut production, crude oil prices rose.

notes:
A frequently used term in news about energy markets and international politics. Composed of {産油|さんゆ} (oil production) + {国|こく} (country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産油国|さんゆこく}⟦{機構|きこう}→機構：02784_kikou⟧: organization of oil-producing countries (i.e., OPEC)
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}: major oil-producing countries
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{有数|ゆうすう}→有数：13006_yuusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}: one of the world's leading oil-producing countries
- {産油国|さんゆこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: the economies of oil-producing countries
- ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧{産油国|さんゆこく}: non-oil-producing countries

RELATED WORDS:
- OPEC / ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧{輸出国機構|ゆしゅつこくきこう}: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
- ⟦{原油|げんゆ}→原油：21637_genyu⟧: crude oil
- ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧: petroleum; oil
- {消費国|しょうひこく}: consumer country — the opposite side of the oil trade
- {埋蔵量|まいぞうりょう}: (underground) reserves

USAGE:
Japan is not a {産油国|さんゆこく} and imports almost all its oil, so the word often appears in Japanese news from the perspective of a country affected by producers' decisions.
